title: Sausage and Peppers
description: Browned Italian sausages with sweet peppers and onions cooked down with garlic and a splash of tomato. Serve in rolls or over polenta.

image.alt: A skillet of sausages with red and green peppers and onions

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the skillet over medium heat. Add the sausages, cover and cook, turning now and then, until browned on all sides, {time 10 min}. Move to a board.
Add the rest of the oil, the onion, peppers, salt and oregano. Cook, stirring now and then, until soft and lightly browned, {time 10 min}. Add the garlic for {time 1 min}.
Slice the sausages thickly on an angle and return them to the pan with the tomatoes and a splash of water.
Cover and simmer until the sausages are cooked through, {time 8-10 min}. They should read {temp 160F internal}. Serve in rolls, over polenta or with crusty bread.

notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge and reheats well.
